text: Reports of a drone strike on the eastern side of Zalingei this morning, near the grain market. Several casualties feared. Unconfirmed so far.
Correction on the strike this morning: it was not at the grain market, it hit close to the water point on the road north of town.
Two more strikes heard from the same direction in the last hour. Families are moving away from the north road.
Smoke visible over the north road now

Daily roundup: fighting continues around the state capital per agency wires; an aid convoy reached the eastern locality yesterday; markets in the south partially reopened. Sources: radio bulletins and agency reporting.
All staff please share your movement plans for tomorrow with the security focal point before 17:00.
Thanks everyone, have a good evening.
Hearing a rumour of a new checkpoint being set up on the west road out of town. Rumour only for now, no confirmation.
Strikes reported this evening on the Galaxy compound south of town. Details to follow.
About yesterday's report on the Galaxy compound: this turned out to be misreporting. No strikes on the compound took place.
